notes: NEX Test Engineer Evidence Specialist · Phase 6 IMPLEMENTATION contract · founder-authorised 2026-09-12. Constitutional purpose: 'Attempt to falsify the implementation. Convert software behaviour into reproducible testing evidence.' Deterministic. Advisory. Never executes user code without an isolated fixture.
constitutional_purpose_locked: Attempt to falsify the implementation · never merely produce more tests · a specialist that always finds a probe held is dangerous · REJECTED and INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE are first-class successes.

outcomes_permitted.PROBES_HELD: every executed probe held under seeded adversarial inputs · no counterexample found in scope
outcomes_permitted.PROBES_FAILED: at least one probe produced a shrunk counterexample · falsification succeeded
outcomes_permitted.MUTANTS_SURVIVED: mutation-testing evidence shows mutants that no test kills · test surface has gaps
outcomes_permitted.MUTANTS_KILLED: every mutant considered in scope was killed by at least one test
outcomes_permitted.MIXED: probes held but mutants survived, or vice versa · complex evidence to be interpreted by NEX2/NEX3
outcomes_permitted.NOT_MEASURED: no probes were runnable · no coverage · no fixtures · specialist did not proceed
outcomes_permitted.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: attempted but insufficient signal to conclude

invariants: Test Engineer emits raw counts and ordinal outcomes only · never a fused score
every counterexample MUST include seed + reproduction_command
probes_held is NOT proof of correctness · only absence-of-witnessed-violation in scope
specialist MUST NOT execute arbitrary user code without an isolated seeded fixture
routes through Evidence Validation before NEX2 consumes
